name: Control
short: One panel for every cog's settings, plus a slash /help.
description: Adds a single /control panel where server admins can view and change the settings of every cog that supports it, and a /help menu that lists every loaded cog's slash commands by category, showing each member only the commands they can use.
author: itsneufox
install_msg: Control loaded! Open the panel with `[p]control`, or use `/help` to browse slash commands. For the slash versions, run `[p]slash enablecog control` and then `[p]slash sync`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any data.
